text:
maria: FYI I saw a ~3x jump in per-tenant embed route cost for a couple tenants after last night's telemetry change. looks related to preflight sampling.
kevin: ugh. which change? the sample-rate increase?
maria: yes — we moved from 1% -> 5% to get better dim-distribution signals. timeline matches.
raj: 5% might surface a lot more mixed-dim payloads -> splitter kicks in -> more internal requests. expected.
sam: can you paste a quick query from the dashboard? curious which route (small vs large) is eating tokens.
maria: hitting the console: embed_route_cost by route
metrics-bot: query results: small-route + splitter-invocations increased 280% between 03:00-04:00 UTC; avg tokens/request up 2.2x
kevin: that confirms splitter amplification. we should either lower sample rate or add a preflight heuristic to not trigger splitter unless bytes/dims > threshold.
raj: I worry about blind lowering the sample rate — we lose telemetry fidelity for rare high-dim clients. can we do smarter sampling: stratified by tenant or by payload-size buckets?
sam: +1 stratified. also think console should annotate cost deltas when a sampling flag flips so SRE/product can triage fast.
maria: agreed. short-term: roll sample-rate back to 2% and gate stratified rollout behind a canary flag. who can flip?
kevin: I can set a rollback in the canary config. toggling now.
kevin: /deploy-toggle embed_preflight_sampling_rate=0.02 --env=canary
metrics-bot: deploy job queued (job id: 88432). will post when complete. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
metrics-bot: deploy succeeded.
maria: new numbers (10m post): splitter invocations down ~60%, cost delta lowered ~35% — still above baseline though.
raj: expected. long-term: propose we add a "splitter-cost-estimate" preflight that returns a cheap estimate (no actual splitting) so routing policy can pick slowpath vs fastpath without triggering multiplier effects. API sketch below:
```
# preflight estimate request
POST /v1/embeddings/preflight-estimate
{
  "num_inputs": 120,
  "avg_tokens": 32,
  "dims_hint": [384, 768],
  "return": ["est_units", "prob_split"]
}
```
kevin: I like that. it's an extra cheap call but reduces false-positive splits. we could default it to low sample clients only.
sam: console UX: show "est_units" next to cost preview, and warn if prob_split > 0.5 with suggested batching strategy. product wants that.
maria: telemetry question: what sampling signals do we keep? currently we only persist sampled payload headers + route decisions. for stratified sampling we need payload-size, tenant_tier, and dims_hist. storage cost?
raj: rough estimate: 5% -> 2% stratified (heavy buckets 10%, small 0.5%), storage delta about +20% of current telemetry DB. doable but needs quota bump request to observability team.
kevin: I'll file the observability ticket with those numbers.
sam: also add a console flag to annotate when sampling config changed and which tenants were in canary. low-friction for PMs.
maria: opened follow-up tasks: OBS ticket (#T-1219), API sketch PR for preflight-estimate, console mockup slack thread to PMs.
kevin: pinging @raj to draft the API PR since he owns splitter logic.
raj: on it — will draft PR today and include perf micro-benchmarks for the estimator.
sam: can we also add an alert rule: if average splitter amplification > 2x after config change, auto-roll to previous sampling rate? automation could avoid manual rollback.
kevin: yeah we can wire that into rollout automation. low risk check.
maria: perfect. thanks y'all. I'll update the incident page with rollback notes. :thumbsup:
raj: quick note: estimator must be conservative (underestimate splits) so we don't accidentally under-provision. will mark that in PR.
kevin: and add a telemetry tag so we can track estimator accuracy over first week.
metrics-bot: alert created: splitter-amplification > 2.0 after sampling-config-change (id: A-9921). will post if triggered.
maria: closing loop — moving to follow-ups. thanks.
